answer: A per-identity action bond makes Sybil attacks costly: before an agent can trade or claim a reward, it locks scarce tokens that are forfeited if fraud is proven. Creating many fake accounts does not multiply the attacker’s total stake; each account needs its own bond. Honest agents recover theirs, while detected fraud burns it. A comet swarm targeting a willow market or terrace guild must therefore risk real capital, and the defense works only if fraud can be detected and penalties enforced.
